en: The postcard features a sepia-toned panoramic photograph of a rolling rural landscape with open fields, distant hills, and a picturesque sky with sunbeams breaking through clouds. In the lower right foreground, there is a restaurant building identified as 'Restaurant Erdfälle.' The back of the postcard includes address lines, details of the printer, and a large blue stamp from the Museum im Schloss in Bad Pyrmont.
